__inputs.name: DS_CLICKHOUSE
__inputs.label: ClickHouse (mart)
__inputs.description: mart.agg_token_model_cost_1d_dist 등 mart-metrics 4테이블 + fact.raw_token_metrics_{summary,serving}_1d_dist 조회용 — 공유 계정 mart (docs/monitoring/README.md §7 참조)

panels.title: 1. 모델별 일별 model_cost_krw (serving/standby 분해)
panels.description: M1 agg_token_model_cost_1d_dist — 모델별 C = Σ(serving+standby, 비FAIL) gpu_hours × TCO (측정). serving_cost/standby_cost = C × 시간 비례 분해(기종 혼합 행은 근사). TCO 부재 행이 하나라도 있으면 그 날·모델은 NULL.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date AS time,
    model,
    if(countIf(model_cost_krw IS NULL) > 0, NULL, sum(model_cost_krw)) AS model_cost_krw,
    if(countIf(model_cost_krw IS NULL) > 0, NULL,
       sum(ifNull(model_cost_krw * serving_gpu_hours / nullIf(serving_gpu_hours + standby_gpu_hours, 0), 0))) AS serving_cost_krw,
    if(countIf(model_cost_krw IS NULL) > 0, NULL,
       sum(ifNull(model_cost_krw * standby_gpu_hours / nullIf(serving_gpu_hours + standby_gpu_hours, 0), 0))) AS standby_cost_krw
FROM mart.agg_token_model_cost_1d_dist
WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
  AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
  AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, model
ORDER BY time, model

panels.title: 2. 서비스별 총비용 (측정, 배부 미적용)
panels.description: 설계 §6.2 P0-core — 서비스별 Σ M1 model_cost_krw (그 서비스가 호스팅한 모델의 C 합, 공유 모델 배분 전). 배분 후 서비스 비용은 패널 10(M4 합산).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date AS time,
    service,
    if(countIf(model_cost_krw IS NULL) > 0, NULL, sum(model_cost_krw)) AS service_cost_krw,
    '측정 (배부 미적용)' AS cost_label
FROM mart.agg_token_model_cost_1d_dist
WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
  AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
  AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, service
ORDER BY time, service

panels.title: 3. 서비스×모델 GPU 시간·비용 (당일)
panels.description: M1 — 선택 범위 안의 최신 집계일(max(date)) 한 날의 service×model 행. krw_per_request = model_cost_krw / requests (요청당 원가, 정의서 §7).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date,
    service_group,
    service,
    model,
    serving_gpu_hours,
    standby_gpu_hours,
    test_gpu_hours,
    flagged_gpu_hours,
    equiv_gpu_count,
    model_cost_krw,
    requests,
    round(model_cost_krw / nullIf(requests, 0), 2) AS krw_per_request,
    tokens_per_gpu_hour,
    quality_flag,
    '측정' AS cost_label
FROM mart.agg_token_model_cost_1d_dist
WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
  AND date = (SELECT max(date) FROM mart.agg_token_model_cost_1d_dist WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime))
  AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
  AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
ORDER BY model_cost_krw DESC NULLS LAST, service, model

panels.title: 4. 서비스별 tokens_per_gpu_hour 추이
panels.description: M1 — 서비스별 Σ total_tokens / Σ serving_gpu_hours (분모 0이면 NULL).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date AS time,
    service,
    sum(total_tokens) / nullIf(sum(serving_gpu_hours), 0) AS tokens_per_gpu_hour
FROM mart.agg_token_model_cost_1d_dist
WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
  AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
  AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, service
ORDER BY time, service

panels.title: 5. 토큰 단가 p (파생 — 기준월·가동률 병기)
panels.description: 정의서 3.7 — p = Σ C(model) / Σ W(model) (원/가중토큰 → ×1e6 = 원/1M 가중토큰), p_cached = 0.1p, p_output = 4p. 기준월 = base_month(toStartOfMonth), 가동률 = utilization_pct(M2 Σ reported / Σ allocated, 같은 달·같은 그룹; 할당표 없으면 NULL). 배분의 결과이지 비용 입력이 아니다(순환) — 정보용.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    c.base_month AS base_month,
    c.service_group AS service_group,
    c.model AS model,
    c.model_cost_krw AS model_cost_krw,
    c.weighted_tokens AS weighted_tokens,
    round(c.model_cost_krw / nullIf(c.weighted_tokens, 0) * 1000000, 2) AS p_krw_per_m_wtoken,
    round(c.model_cost_krw / nullIf(c.weighted_tokens, 0) * 1000000 * 0.1, 2) AS p_cached_krw_per_m,
    round(c.model_cost_krw / nullIf(c.weighted_tokens, 0) * 1000000 * 4, 2) AS p_output_krw_per_m,
    round(g.utilization * 100, 1) AS utilization_pct,
    '파생' AS cost_label
FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfMonth(date) AS base_month,
           service_group,
           model,
           if(countIf(model_cost_krw IS NULL) > 0, NULL, sum(model_cost_krw)) AS model_cost_krw,
           sum(weighted_tokens) AS weighted_tokens
    FROM mart.agg_token_model_cost_1d_dist
    WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
      AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
    GROUP BY base_month, service_group, model
) AS c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT toStartOfMonth(date) AS base_month,
           service_group,
           sum(reported_gpu_hours_total) / nullIf(sum(allocated_gpu_hours), 0) AS utilization
    FROM mart.agg_token_gpu_group_1d_dist
    WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
      AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
    GROUP BY base_month, service_group
) AS g ON g.base_month = c.base_month AND g.service_group = c.service_group
ORDER BY base_month DESC, service_group, model

panels.title: 6. quality_flag 분포
panels.description: M1 — 선택 범위의 quality_flag 별 행수 (partial > no_tco > flagged > manual > no_metrics > consumer_only > normal).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    quality_flag,
    count() AS row_count,
    countIf(model_cost_krw IS NULL) AS cost_null_rows,
    countIf(has_gpu_rows = 0) AS no_gpu_rows,
    countIf(has_token_rows = 0) AS no_token_rows
FROM mart.agg_token_model_cost_1d_dist
WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
  AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
  AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY quality_flag
ORDER BY row_count DESC

panels.title: 7. 검사 결과 (FAIL/WARN)
panels.description: M3 token_metrics_check_1d_dist — severity FAIL/WARN 행 (INFO 제외). detail 은 사용자 식별자·payload 를 담지 않는다(마스터 §5.6).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date,
    service_group,
    service,
    check_name,
    severity,
    model,
    gpu_type,
    observed,
    threshold,
    detail,
    source_type
FROM mart.token_metrics_check_1d_dist
WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
  AND severity IN ('FAIL', 'WARN')
  AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
  AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
ORDER BY date DESC, severity, service, check_name
LIMIT 500

panels.title: 8. 일별 FAIL/WARN 건수
panels.description: M3 — 일별 severity 별 검사 건수.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date AS time,
    severity,
    count() AS checks
FROM mart.token_metrics_check_1d_dist
WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
  AND severity IN ('FAIL', 'WARN')
  AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
  AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, severity
ORDER BY time, severity

panels.title: 9. 모델 비용 배분 (share)
panels.description: M4 agg_token_model_share_1d_dist — share = W(s,m)/W(m), allocated_cost_krw = model_cost_krw × share (배분) / 사외 API 는 벤더 단가 (추정).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date,
    model,
    service,
    service_group,
    provider_service,
    is_provider,
    denominator_mode,
    share,
    model_cost_krw,
    allocated_cost_krw,
    quality_flag,
    multiIf(denominator_mode = 'external_api', '추정',
            denominator_mode = 'token_not_reported', '그룹 귀속',
            '배분') AS cost_label
FROM mart.agg_token_model_share_1d_dist
WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
  AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
  AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
ORDER BY date DESC, model, share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 500

panels.title: 10. 서비스별 배분 총비용 (M4 합산, stretch)
panels.description: 설계 §6.2 stretch — 서비스별 Σ allocated_cost_krw 를 cost_label(배분/추정/그룹 귀속) 별로 합산(§6.4 (6) ①②③). 패널 2(배부 미적용)와 나란히 본다. NULL 행이 하나라도 있으면 그 (날, 서비스, 라벨) 합은 NULL.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date,
    service,
    multiIf(denominator_mode = 'external_api', '추정',
            denominator_mode = 'token_not_reported', '그룹 귀속',
            '배분') AS cost_label,
    if(countIf(allocated_cost_krw IS NULL) > 0, NULL, sum(allocated_cost_krw)) AS service_allocated_cost_krw,
    count() AS model_rows
FROM mart.agg_token_model_share_1d_dist
WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
  AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
  AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY date, service, cost_label
ORDER BY date DESC, service, cost_label
LIMIT 500

panels.title: 11. 그룹 GPU 정체성 (I2)
panels.description: M2 agg_token_gpu_group_1d_dist — 그룹 총비용(allocated×TCO) = model_cost_sum(ΣC) + test_cost(실험) + idle_cost(유휴) + unattributed(미귀속) (identity_gap_krw ≈ 0 이 정상, over_report=1 은 보고 > 배정).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date,
    service_group,
    gpu_type,
    allocated_gpu_hours,
    reported_gpu_hours_total,
    serving_gpu_hours,
    standby_gpu_hours,
    test_gpu_hours,
    flagged_gpu_hours,
    idle_gpu_hours,
    utilization,
    group_total_cost_krw,
    model_cost_sum_krw,
    test_cost_krw,
    idle_cost_krw,
    unattributed_cost_krw,
    identity_gap_krw,
    over_report,
    allocation_source,
    quality_flag,
    '측정' AS cost_label
FROM mart.agg_token_gpu_group_1d_dist
WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
  AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
ORDER BY date DESC, service_group, gpu_type
LIMIT 500

panels.title: 12. 그룹 utilization 추이
panels.description: M2 — service_group/gpu_type 별 utilization = reported_gpu_hours_total / allocated_gpu_hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date AS time,
    concat(service_group, '/', gpu_type) AS group_gpu,
    avg(utilization) AS utilization
FROM mart.agg_token_gpu_group_1d_dist
WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
  AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, group_gpu
ORDER BY time, group_gpu

panels.title: 13. TTFT/ITL 추이 (p50/p95)
panels.description: 성능 fact raw_token_metrics_serving_1d_dist — service×model 단위 ttft_ms/itl_ms 의 p50·p95(ms). source_type(metrics-api-v1 | manual-v0) 병기. custom 지표·e2e/output_tps 는 제외.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date AS time,
    concat(service, '/', model, ' ', metric) AS series,
    source_type,
    avg(p50) AS p50,
    avg(p95) AS p95
FROM fact.raw_token_metrics_serving_1d_dist
WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
  AND metric IN ('ttft_ms', 'itl_ms')
  AND name = ''
  AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
  AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, series, source_type
ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: 14. 출처 (manual-v0 vs API)
panels.description: 앵커 fact raw_token_metrics_summary_1d_dist — 날짜별 source_type 별 보고 서비스 수 (manual-v0 = 수기 CSV, metrics-api-v1 = API).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date AS time,
    source_type,
    countDistinct(service) AS services
FROM fact.raw_token_metrics_summary_1d_dist
WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
  AND service_group IN (${service_group:singlequote})
  AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, source_type
ORDER BY time, source_type

panels.title: 15. 일별 메트릭 커버리지
panels.description: 앵커 fact raw_token_metrics_summary_1d_dist — 보고 서비스 수(reported_services) vs 기대 서비스 수(expected_services = 마커 metrics_coverage 분모: 레지스트리 enabled=1 AND coverage_since ≤ date AND (until IS NULL OR date ≤ until), 날짜별). rejected_rows > 0 이면 6b 정규화 거부 행 존재.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    f.date AS date,
    f.reported_services AS reported_services,
    e.expected_services AS expected_services,
    f.gpu_rows AS gpu_rows,
    f.serving_rows AS serving_rows,
    f.rejected_rows AS rejected_rows,
    f.manual_services AS manual_services
FROM (
    SELECT date,
           countDistinct(service) AS reported_services,
           sum(gpu_rows) AS gpu_rows,
           sum(serving_rows) AS serving_rows,
           sum(rejected_rows) AS rejected_rows,
           countIf(source_type = 'manual-v0') AS manual_services
    FROM fact.raw_token_metrics_summary_1d_dist
    WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
    GROUP BY date
) AS f
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT d.date AS date,
           countIf(r.enabled = 1 AND r.coverage_since <= d.date AND (isNull(r.until) OR d.date <= r.until)) AS expected_services
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT date FROM fact.raw_token_metrics_summary_1d_dist WHERE date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)) AS d
    CROSS JOIN gpu_data.dim_token_metrics_service_dist AS r
    GROUP BY d.date
) AS e ON e.date = f.date
ORDER BY date DESC

options.content:
**참고 — BATCH_RESULT 마커 패널 (미포함)**

이 대시보드는 mart 4테이블(`mart.agg_token_model_cost_1d_dist` 등)과 앵커 fact `fact.raw_token_metrics_summary_1d_dist`·성능 fact `fact.raw_token_metrics_serving_1d_dist`의 실적 행만 관측합니다. CronJob `token-mart-metrics`(10:20 KST) 실행 자체의 판정은 로그 마커 기반입니다:

`BATCH_RESULT status=SUCCESS|FAILURE module=mart-metrics metrics_coverage=<present>/<enabled> missing_services="a,b|-" rows_mart=<n> rows_check=<n> rows_share=<n> warn=<n> elapsed=<s> [reason=<r>]`

마커 조회에는 VictoriaLogs 데이터소스가 필요합니다 — 홈랩(stage)에는 없어 이 대시보드에는 포함하지 않았고, company 단계에서 기존 `batch_result` 대시보드에 module `mart-metrics`로 편입됩니다 (`kubectl -n monitoring logs job/<job> | grep BATCH_RESULT` 로 대체 가능).

**라벨 규칙 (docs/cost-model-spec.md §7)** — `cost_label` 컬럼: `측정` = GPU 시간 × TCO(M1·M2; 패널 2의 `측정 (배부 미적용)` = 서비스별 Σ M1 C, 공유 모델 배분 전), `배분` = 가중 토큰 비율(1/0.1/4)로 나눈 공유 모델 비용(M4), `추정` = 사외 API 벤더 단가 기반(M4 `external_api`), `그룹 귀속` = 토큰 미보고 모델의 호스팅 그룹 전액 귀속, `파생` = 토큰 단가 p = C ÷ W(정의서 3.7 — 비용 입력이 아니라 배분의 결과, 기준월·가동률 병기). 비용 NULL = TCO/단가 부재(`no_tco`·`vendor_price_missing`) — 0이 아니라 '측정 불가'입니다.
